## 策略优化与连续控制

| 归档年 | 论文与导读 | PDF | 阅读问题 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1999 | [Policy Gradient Methods for Reinforcement Learning with Function Approximation](1999-policy-gradient-function-approximation.md) | [PDF](../../pdfs/reinforcement-learning/1999-policy-gradient-function-approximation.pdf) | 假设智能体可以向左或向右走。稍微调高向右走的概率，会改变眼前的动作选择，也会改变之后更常到达的状态。要判断这次调整能否提高长期回报，是否还得知道环境如何响应，并对每个状态的访… |
| 2015 | [Trust Region Policy Optimization](2015-trpo.md) | [PDF](../../pdfs/reinforcement-learning/2015-trpo.pdf) | 策略梯度沿好方向移动过远时，采样数据所代表的状态分布会失效，怎样控制一次更新的幅度？ |
| 2017 | [Proximal Policy Optimization Algorithms](2017-ppo.md) | [PDF](../../pdfs/reinforcement-learning/2017-ppo.pdf) | 如何在多轮小批量更新中控制策略变化？ |
| 2018 | [Addressing Function Approximation Error in Actor-Critic Methods](2018-td3.md) | [PDF](../../pdfs/reinforcement-learning/2018-td3.pdf) | 当策略追逐近似价值函数的高点时，估值误差如何在连续控制中累积？ |
| 2018 | [Soft Actor-Critic: Off-Policy Maximum Entropy Deep Reinforcement Learning with a Stochastic Actor](2018-sac.md) | [PDF](../../pdfs/reinforcement-learning/2018-sac.pdf) | 如何结合奖励与熵目标训练离策略随机控制策略？ |

## 离线决策与语言推理

| 归档年 | 论文与导读 | PDF | 阅读问题 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 2016 | [Doubly Robust Off-policy Value Evaluation for Reinforcement Learning](2016-doubly-robust-off-policy-evaluation.md) | [PDF](../../pdfs/reinforcement-learning/2016-doubly-robust-off-policy-evaluation.pdf) | 只有旧策略产生的轨迹时，怎样估计换用新策略后的平均回报？直接在拟合的环境模型里模拟，模型误差可能累积；按新旧策略选择动作的概率之比给日志加权，又可能让少数轨迹主导估计。 |
| 2021 | [Decision Transformer: Reinforcement Learning via Sequence Modeling](2021-decision-transformer.md) | [PDF](../../pdfs/reinforcement-learning/2021-decision-transformer.pdf) | 能否只用现成的轨迹，通过指定目标回报让模型生成动作？ |
| 2025 | [DeepSeek-R1: Incentivizing Reasoning Capability in LLMs via Reinforcement Learning](2025-deepseek-r1.md) | [PDF](../../pdfs/reinforcement-learning/2025-deepseek-r1.pdf) | 在答案可判定的任务上，只给结果奖励能否塑造更长的推理行为？ |
